summary: Fairfax Financial Holdings filed a Form 6-K announcing a C$300 million add-on offering of its 4.40% Senior Notes due 2036, priced at C$98.991 per C$100 principal amount plus accrued interest. The notes are unsecured, share the same terms as C$400 million of outstanding Original 2036 Notes, and are offered via a syndicate led by BMO Nesbitt Burns Inc. as sole bookrunner. Proceeds are for general corporate purposes, including refinancing, debt repayment, or acquisitions. Expected close is June 19, 2026. This is a routine debt-capital-markets transaction; no special-situation dynamics apply.
